deadline.value: Fall 2027 international application closing date is July 15, 2027 (Spring 2027 international closing date: December 15; Summer not open to international students). Priority consideration for university assistantships or fellowships is January 15, 2027.
deadline.quote: For fall applicants, the date for priority consideration for university assistantships or fellowships is January 15. | Application closing dates: | International application: July 15 | Note: International students may only apply for fall or spring.

toefl_min.value: Department requires TOEFL iBT 80 (4 on the post-1/21/2026 1-6 scale), Duolingo 110, or PTE Academic 58 — higher than the university general minimum of 72.
toefl_min.quote: International students should have a minimum English Proficiency score of TOEFL iBT 80 (New TOEFL 2026 score of 4), IELTS 6.5, Duolingo 110 or the Pearsons PTE Academic 58.

ielts_min.value: Department requires IELTS 6.5 minimum (higher than the university general minimum of 6.0).
ielts_min.quote: International students should have a minimum English Proficiency score of TOEFL iBT 80 (New TOEFL 2026 score of 4), IELTS 6.5, Duolingo 110 or the Pearsons PTE Academic 58.

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for Chemistry (ETS discontinued the Chemistry Subject Test in May 2023; offers Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics, and Psychology).
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

supervisor.value: Program and catalog pages do not state whether a supervisor must be secured before admission.

funding.value: A limited number of graduate research and teaching assistantships are available on a competitive basis.
funding.quote: You will be eligible for graduate assistantships for research and/or teaching activities. | A limited number of assistantships are available on a competitive basis. This award is subject to the work needs of the position and department, your satisfactory performance of duties, your academic record, and availability of funds, and may be subject to change.

entry_route.value: Admits holders of a bachelor's degree (minimum 55 credits required beyond the BS) or an earned master's degree in chemistry or biochemistry (eligible for Advanced Standing with a minimum of 8 credits from formal courses).
entry_route.quote: A minimum of 55 course credits is required beyond the BS, including at least 24 credits of formal courses, at least 27 credits of doctoral dissertation research, and 4 credits of Graduate Seminar. | If you enter the program with an earned master's degree in chemistry or biochemistry you may be eligible to receive Advanced Standing in the doctoral program. You will complete a minimum of 8 credits from formal courses.

notes: 2026-2027 catalog entry (poid=12724) confirms Advanced Standing for earned MS holders (minimum 8 formal course credits).
